cohort: The cohort consisted of 293 mother-newborn pairs from hospitalized pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 who delivered at Imam Reza Hospital, Mashhad, Iran, between April 2021 and March 2022.
finding: Specific maternal inflammatory, coagulation, and immune parameters were found to be predictive of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including preterm birth, stillbirth, and low birth weight, in COVID-19-positive pregnancies.
